title: Repair shared Gallery CPU session recreation
requires: Linux CPU installed SDK/Gallery toolchain and the exact candidate-v8 failure archive
scope: Repair the mandatory shared Gallery CPU lifecycle failure exposed by F8-53 on exact candidate realtime-single-step-v1-c05d320. Reproduce the first-session pass followed by MobileGallerySession recreation failure from docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-53-CANDIDATE-V8-CPU-GALLERY-FAILURE.json, establish the loader/driver/session lifetime root cause, and preserve the CPU driver's truthful rigid/constraint-only capability set across repeated create, destroy and recreate cycles. Do not advertise unsupported domains, retain sessions forever, remove teardown/recreation, weaken scene requirements, skip the test or hide errors. Candidate v8 remains rejected for final CPU qualification and none of its partial passing observations can be unioned with repaired-source evidence.
acceptance: Reproduce the exact candidate-v8 failure before repair from source c05d320 and retain hash-bound before/after output. Add a focused regression that fails for the same capability/lifetime reason before the production fix.

Repeated shared Gallery and MobileGallerySession create, destroy and recreate cycles select the same CPU device for the required rigid scene, complete normal ticks, reset scenes and recover after background/foreground transitions without leaked or stale loader, driver, instance, device or scene state.

The CPU backend continues to advertise only implemented rigid, constraint and geometry behavior. The 15 unadvertised domain/coupling/quality tests remain explicit unsupported skips; no capability, scene requirement, negative control, schedule, budget or quality assertion is reduced.

A clean Release build passes every required registered CPU test, the focused lifecycle regression, shared Gallery contract/clock/timing/reset/background/failure recovery, isolated discovery/launcher checks and installed SDK relocation with --require-realtime-driver, with and without the validation layer.

Attach exact source/tree, binary, manifest, installed SDK, capability observation and raw before/after artifact hashes for F8-70. Preserve candidate-v8 failure evidence as immutable history and do not claim final qualification from the repair source.
